newsitem.title: USA: Healthdyne amendment may resurface in Ga.
newsitem.headline: Healthdyne amendment may resurface in Ga.

text.p: A state legislative measure that would help Healthdyne Technologies Inc fight off a hostile takeover by Invacare Corp was expected to reach a House-Senate conference committee on Thursday, state officials said.

Both the Georgia House and Senate would name members to a committee charged to work out a compromise early in the day. Any measure agreed to by the panel then would be resubmitted to both chambers for approval, state officials said.
Because Thursday was to be the final day of Georgia's 1997 legislative session, action could come as late as midnight.
The measure is an amendment that the Senate attached to a routine House bill last week. Senators approved the legislation by a 52-1 vote on Friday.
The House, which had already approved the bill without the amendment, disagreed with the changes and sent it back to the Senate. The Senate then insisted on the amendment.
The amendment would require publicly traded companies based in Georgia to stagger the election of directors.
